lodDetails: All four levels preserve the projecting Rococo front, paired circular belfries and the connected tiled roofs. Near views add stone relief, divided shutters and the tower details.
limitations: The present church’s 32-point footprint, round belfry bases and entrances follow OpenStreetMap. Standing upper levels, masonry joints and unseen roof transitions are architectural estimates.
